items.title: Mid-November 2026 Funding Opportunities
items.one_liner: Thirty-four new funding opportunities covering agriculture, climate, environment, energy, and food were released.
items.why: Crucial for identifying potential research grants to support field studies on urban ecosystem services.
items.action: Scan the listed opportunities for grants matching urban environmental planning in data-scarce settings.

items.title: Extreme rainfalls flood Sri Lanka’s coastal city
items.one_liner: Extreme rainfall flooded a Sri Lankan coastal city as local wetlands and drains vanished due to development.
items.why: Demonstrates the real-world impact of wetland loss on stormwater runoff retention and urban flooding.
items.action: Use this case study to examine hydrological disruption caused by land-cover change.

items.title: COP31 draft drops fossil fuel phase-out, gender pledges
items.one_liner: The latest COP31 text draft dropped previous references to fossil fuel phase-outs and gender pledges.
items.why: Reflects global policy negotiations and compromises affecting urban climate mitigation strategies.
items.action: Compare draft iterations to understand political constraints on international climate agreements.

items.title: Multi-Scale Framework Balances Grassland Resilience Trade-Offs
items.one_liner: A multi-scale framework was introduced to balance trade-offs in grassland climate resilience.
items.why: Provides modeling methodologies relevant to landscape configuration and ecological trade-off analyses.
items.action: Examine the multi-scale framework for applicability to peri-urban agricultural landscapes.

items.title: EU bans plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries
items.one_liner: The EU implemented restrictions banning plastic waste exports to non-OECD nations until at least 2029.
items.why: Relevant for studying international regulatory impacts on waste management and trans-boundary environmental flows.
items.action: Examine if similar trade restrictions influence Global South waste-processing landscapes.
items.status_evidence: The restrictions will apply until at least 21 May 2029

items.title: Biophilic Design Framework Connects Green Spaces to Well-Being
items.one_liner: A new biophilic design framework links urban green spaces to measurable mental health and well-being.
items.why: Directly connects to studying human benefits, access to urban nature, and ecosystem service demand.
items.action: Read the framework to integrate mental health metrics into urban green space access evaluations.

items.title: COP31 presidency advances climate agenda with second draft
items.one_liner: The COP31 presidency advanced its climate agenda with a second draft focusing on electrification and finance.
items.why: Provides context on international climate finance and municipal climate adaptation frameworks.
items.action: Monitor COP31 updates regarding urban climate finance gaps and commitments.

items.title: COP31 cities push meets a $4.5 trillion finance gap
items.one_liner: Discussions at COP31 highlighted a massive $4.5 trillion finance gap facing urban climate initiatives.
items.why: Highlights financial barriers to implementing urban environmental planning and green infrastructure.
items.action: Incorporate figures on urban finance shortsets into the economic context of the thesis introduction.

items.title: ENACT launches new investment initiative with Denmark
items.one_liner: ENACT partnered with Denmark to launch an investment initiative accelerating nature-based climate action.
items.why: Directly relevant to funding sources for nature-based solutions and ecosystem-based adaptation.
items.source: International Union for Conservation of Nature
items.action: Investigate eligibility criteria for accessing ENACT-backed nature-based climate investment funds.

items.title: Commission adopts measures restricting lead gunshot
items.one_liner: New EU rules ban the use and sale of gunshot containing 1% or more lead to protect the environment.
items.why: Informs research on environmental pollution controls and habitat quality safeguards in peri-urban areas.
items.action: Review how heavy metal restrictions are modeled in urban and peri-urban wildlife habitats.

items.title: Cork City Climate Change Risk Assessment 2026
items.one_liner: Cork City Council released its 2026 climate change risk assessment detailing local vulnerabilities.
items.why: Offers a methodological reference for municipal climate risk assessments and spatial vulnerability mapping.
items.action: Review the assessment methodology for transferable approaches to urban climate vulnerability.

items.title: An Engaging 2026 CitiesAlive in NYC
items.one_liner: The CitiesAlive event in New York City provided energizing insights and networking for urban green infrastructure.
items.why: Highlights current practical methods and innovations in green infrastructure and stormwater management.
items.action: Check conference proceedings for papers addressing green roofs and stormwater retention.

note: Selected updates, not comprehensive coverage. Status is unverified unless supported by the quoted official excerpt.
